description: This script provides command-line utilities for merging, pruning, and manipulating JSON files, including functions for loading, saving, merging, and pruning JSON data, as well as a main function that processes command-line arguments to perform these operations.

methods.name: process_cmd_line
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for input/output files and JSON modifications.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that processes input JSON, applies additions or subtractions, and writes output.

methods.name: json_load
methods.description: Loads JSON data from a specified file.

methods.name: json_dump
methods.description: Dumps JSON data to a specified file with indentation.

methods.name: json_prune
methods.description: Removes specified parts from a JSON object based on a sub-JSON structure.
